Files.retrievalModeQuestion: How should the agent use this document?
Files.fullDocumentDescription: The entire document is provided to the agent on each retrieval. Best for menus, price lists, FAQs, and other small reference documents.
Files.chunkedSearchDescription: The document is split into chunks and the most relevant ones are retrieved. Better for large documents like manuals or policies.
Files.externalProcessingBody: Documents are sent to Dograh's managed Model Proxy Service for parsing and chunking when they are uploaded or edited. Dograh Model Proxy Service does not store or read your documents - the extracted text and embeddings are returned and stored locally in your self-hosted database.

Models.name: Name
Models.llmFallbacksUnavailableDograh: LLM fallbacks are unavailable in Dograh mode.
Models.providerConnectionIntro: Connect provider accounts, like OpenAI, Google Gemini, ElevenLabs using API Keys, then reuse it in your model configurations.
Models.connectAccountWithApiKey: Connect an account with its API key. It is saved to Providers, so every model configuration can use it.

Models.statusCustomFirstChange: Custom settings for this agent save with your first change. Test calls use them at once; publish to apply them to live calls.
Models.statusCustom: Custom settings for this agent. Test calls use them now; publish to apply them to live calls. Switching back to a preset drops them.
Models.statusNoConfig: No configuration chosen yet. Pick one below, or set an organization default in Models.
Models.statusLegacy: This agent has custom model settings saved before named configurations existed. They stay in use until you choose a configuration or switch to Custom.
Models.statusUnavailable: The selected configuration is unavailable. Choose another one below.
Models.modeRealtimeDescription: One speech-to-speech model listens and replies.
Models.modeDograhDescription: Dograh runs the transcriber, LLM and voice for you.
Models.modeCascadeDescription: Pick your own LLM, STT and TTS providers.
Models.realtimeLlmNote: The realtime model holds the conversation. This text LLM handles variable extraction and other background tasks.
Models.embeddingNote: Use the embedding model that indexed this workflow’s knowledge base. Changing it does not reindex documents.
Models.modelsPageDescription: Create named model configurations using your <link>provider connections</link> in Realtime, Dograh, or BYOK mode.
Models.namedModelConfigurationsDescription: Choose a setup for each workflow or make one your org default. Workflows inherit the default unless overridden.
Models.thenSaveFirstConfiguration: , then save your first named model configuration.
Models.archiveDescription: Archived items cannot be selected for future runs. Items still referenced by active configurations or workflows must be unlinked first.
Models.providersPageDescription: Connect provider accounts, like OpenAI, Google Gemini, ElevenLabs using API Keys, then use them in your <link>named model configurations</link>.
Models.providerConnectionsDescription: Add multiple accounts from any provider, including Dograh.
Models.noProviderConnections: No provider connections yet. Add a provider to get started.
Models.fallbackSlowResponseDescription: Start another LLM if the primary has not produced answer text or a tool call within your time limit.
Models.fallbackRequestErrorDescription: Try another LLM on any error before output, including rate limits, billing errors, connection failures, and empty responses.
Models.llmFallbacksIntro: Keep conversations moving when an LLM is slow or unavailable. Each response starts with your primary LLM; the first answer from an eligible request serves that response.
Models.realtimeFallbackNote: These rules apply to the separate text LLM. They do not switch the realtime audio model.
Models.waitBeforeFallbackHint: The primary keeps running until one request produces output. Allowed: 100–10,000 ms.
Models.fallbackConnectionHint: Use a different connection or model from the primary. Add or manage connections in <link>Providers</link>.
Models.duplicateFallbackTarget: Choose a different connection or model from the primary LLM.
Models.fallbacksFootnote: Fallbacks apply only before answer output or tool execution begins. Backup requests can add cost and send conversation data to their configured provider and region. Changes apply to future runs.

Workflow.classifierInstructionsDescription: These instructions decide whether the answering party is a person, a voicemail, a screening service or an IVR menu. Edit them when your calls are not in English: describe the greetings and carrier announcements your callers actually hear. Leave them unchanged to keep following the built-in instructions as they improve; clear the box to go back to them. The reply must be a single label — CONVERSATION, VOICEMAIL, NO_MESSAGE, SCREENER, SCREENING_WAIT, IVR or UNKNOWN. Anything else is read as UNKNOWN, which lets the call through to the agent, so instructions that only answer CONVERSATION or VOICEMAIL will silently disable screening and IVR handling.
